scope: static source review, not runtime determinism proof
findings: The property test uses three fixed default seeds and 24 cases, with environment overrides.
convex-test document IDs use a per-database counter, not random generation.
Document creation time uses Date.now and a monotonic increment; the test mocks Date.now in beforeEach.
convex-test t.run creates a Math.random request ID and passes it to the Convex SDK action invocation.
The SDK places requestId in closures for action, auth, scheduler, storage and vector-search operations; this review follows action and storage construction.
No assertion sensitivity to request IDs is established, and their irrelevance has not been proved.
limitations: Static occurrence is not evidence that a value affects a test outcome.
This is not a complete dependency, effect, clock or randomness audit.
No test cases, seeds, clocks, request IDs or production keys changed.
